messages.content: Flappy Bird 遊戲中最低的分數是多少？

function.name: game_tracker_high_score
function.description: Retrieves the highest score recorded in the specified game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content: 在《Flappy Bird》遊戲裡，玩家可以從零開始。若一開始就撞到牆壁或管道而未通過任何一次，就會得到 **0 分**（即沒有得分）。因此，在這款遊戲中的最低可能分數是 **0 分**。
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Flappy Bird 遊戲中最低的分數是多少?" which translates from Chinese as "What is the lowest score in Flappy Bird game?". They want the minimum possible score? In Flappy Bird, you can start with zero and then each pipe passed increments your score; but if you die immediately after starting, your score might still be zero or maybe one depending on how many pipes you've passed before dying.

But they ask specifically about the lowest score. Usually it's zero because you haven't passed any pipes yet. But some versions may give at least 1 when passing first pipe. However typical answer: Minimum score is 0 points. So we should respond accordingly.

We don't need to call external tool. Just provide answer. Let's do it.
